gen_risks.description: Delays in rollout of EGL program
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide technical assistance and training to support the rollout of the EGL program
gen_risks.evidence: The project will support rolling out both EGR and EGM programs for Grades 1–3 in all provinces

gen_risks.description: Delays in disbursement due to overloaded FM staff
gen_risks.mitigation: Hire additional FM staff and provide training to support disbursement
gen_risks.evidence: The fiduciary risk for the project is rated Moderate

gen_risks.description: Delays in completion of activities due to inadequate budgeting
gen_risks.mitigation: Review and revise the budget to ensure adequate funding for activities
gen_risks.evidence: The project is expected to be completed by 2030

gen_risks.description: Lack of support from local communities
gen_risks.mitigation: Engage with local communities through consultations and inclusive decision-making
gen_risks.evidence: The project will actively involve citizens through extensive consultations

gen_risks.description: Changes in government policies or laws
gen_risks.mitigation: Monitor changes in government policies and laws and adjust the project accordingly
gen_risks.evidence: The project is aligned with the Country Partnership Framework for Cambodia

gen_risks.description: Inadequate climate-resilient construction of school buildings
gen_risks.mitigation: Ensure that school buildings are constructed with climate-resilient materials and designs
gen_risks.evidence: The project will integrate activities to address climate vulnerabilities

gen_risks.mitigation: Provide training and capacity-building support to project staff and leaders
gen_risks.evidence: The project will strengthen the education system’s support to rural and disadvantaged children

gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a contingency plan to respond to natural disasters or economic crises
gen_risks.evidence: Natural disasters caused by climate change pose significant challenges for Cambodia

gt_risks.description: Environment and Social risk is rated Substantial due to (a) limited institutional capacity to manage environmental and social risks and impacts; (b) nationwide implementation of the project's activities; (c) possible exclusion of vulnerable groups (such as poor children, children with disabilities, and indigenous groups); and (d) other risks involving child protection, occupational health and safety, labor issues, and sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment (SEA/SH).
gt_risks.mitigation: The project will develop a capacity-building plan for the Environmental and Social Safeguards Office and Project Management Unit, including hiring dedicated environmental and social specialists and providing targeted training. It will establish robust monitoring mechanisms to ensure support for vulnerable groups (universal design in new school/WASH construction, materials adapted for visually impaired students), strict adherence to worker codes of conduct, complaint redress and referral mechanisms, and construction site safety measures to protect school children and communities from labor influx and construction-related risks.
